title: Mobile play and a refreshed library
changes: A compact *mobile library* with search, touch controls and game details. Install as a web app for a full-screen experience.
A centered app icon, a clearer *Recently Played* history icon and distinct console artwork on mobile and desktop.
*Recently Played restores automatically* when the library opens, including your connected account's cached and cloud history.
Installed web apps use the full display height for the library and games, with your saved touch-button positions preserved.
Installed iPhone/iPad apps request an opaque black system status bar to reduce top-edge fading. Games fill the available display and saved controls remain intact.
*Nextcloud saves* with optional automatic sign-in when enabled. Recently Played and controller layouts sync when connected.
An integrated folder scanner and feed builder, with startup scans and scheduled refreshes when enabled.
*PlayStation discs and larger 3DS ROMs stream during play* and require an internet connection.
*3DS shaders cache as they are created.* New shaders can briefly hitch, especially when many appear at once on mobile.
